title: Minimal real SWAP5 + MODFLOW6 + Ribasim transactional composition
purpose: Qualify one deliberately small three-model window in which a real SWAP management decision is allocated and physically supplied by real Ribasim, the same supplied amount enters real Richards SWAP as top-boundary irrigation, and real SWAP exchanges groundwater with one live MODFLOW6 cell under the closed fixed-interface contract.

swap_richards_modflow.base: F-GC44 one-column one-cell real FMR/SWAP + MODFLOW6 6.8.0
publication_order: designate isolated Ribasim candidate as accepted surface-water state

transaction_pattern: Keep a real Ribasim accepted-origin BMI instance unadvanced.
Run and discard one isolated real Ribasim candidate A; accepted origin must remain unchanged.
Run isolated candidate B from the same serialized Ribasim origin and retain it provisionally.
Build a typed RM10 realization receipt from candidate-B allocation and measured physical supply.
Create but do not commit the SWAP management candidate; verify net irrigation equals physical supply because vegetation cover is zero.
Create the real Richards + MODFLOW candidate from the accepted Richards origin using that net irrigation as the top forcing.
Prepare groundwater and surface-water ledgers before publication.
Only after all preflights pass publish MODFLOW, Richards SWAP, groundwater ledger, management SWAP and finally surface-water acceptance.
On any prepublication failure discard every candidate and leave all accepted origins unchanged.

ledger_contract.surface_water_to_swap: Ribasim UserDemand cumulative physical inflow is the single external gross irrigation transfer. The SWAP management receipt carries the equal receiver quantity. With zero vegetation cover, Richards top-boundary inflow equals the same quantity.
ledger_contract.groundwater_interface: Separate equal-and-opposite SWAP-MODFLOW transfer owned by the existing F-GC groundwater ledger.
ledger_contract.internal_transfers: No groundwater-to-surface-water route; no drainage; no Rutter interception storage in this first triangle.

hypotheses: The real SWAP management decision requests exactly 0.0036 cm over the 1e-4-day event.
Real Ribasim allocates and physically supplies that full request within the RM09 full-realization envelope.
The accepted Ribasim origin is unchanged by discarded candidate A and candidate-B replay is identical.
The RM10 typed realization receipt binds the Ribasim return to the exact SWAP management origin.
Zero-cover Rutter processing returns net irrigation equal to gross physical supply.
Real Richards SWAP with top irrigation active and live MODFLOW6 fixed-interface coupling converges inside the inherited F-GC44 transaction envelope.
Rejected real Richards correctors do not mutate accepted SWAP state or groundwater ledger.
Surface-water and groundwater ledgers remain separate and each close exactly once.
After publication the Richards SWAP and management SWAP revisions each advance exactly once; the Ribasim accepted state is candidate B and the original Ribasim witness remains unchanged.

Repeating the complete prepublication candidate sequence from the same accepted origins reproduces the same Ribasim supply, SWAP management net irrigation, coupled groundwater endpoint and transfer ledgers.
failure_rule: Do not widen the irrigation depth, groundwater head envelope, drainage/root physics or numerical tolerances after execution. Repair only technical integration failures. A Richards+MODFLOW failure under the frozen top forcing is a composition-envelope falsification and must remain visible.
nonclaims: No groundwater influence on a later management demand; that is the next causal falsification workunit.
No arbitrary Ribasim topology or competing demand.
No production iMOD Coupler driver integration.
The isolated Ribasim candidate pattern is qualification transaction evidence, not a claimed native Ribasim checkpoint API.
